course_name_original: English B2 course - compulsory course of 135 hours for students of FIRST-CYCLE studies - semester 1/3
course_name_en: English B2 course - compulsory course of 135 hours for students of FIRST-CYCLE studies - semester 1/3
prerequisites: English language proficiency at least at A-2 level.

learning_outcomes.text: Can write understandable informational and argumentative texts on general and industry topics, conduct correspondence typical for the work environment, and independently use didactic materials.
Understands longer, even complex written and oral statements, e.g., lectures and presentations, provided they concern industry issues and current affairs, and can interpret the acquired information.
Can present conclusions and opinions on general, academic, and professional topics clearly in written and oral form.

Can use grammatical structures, phraseology, and vocabulary that allow for understanding general texts describing contemporary economic and social phenomena, academic and industry-specific texts, and allow for fairly fluent and spontaneous communication in academic and professional environments.
Can prepare oral presentations on academic and industry topics and participate in discussions fairly fluently and spontaneously, including in a professional environment.

assessment_rules: The condition for passing is obtaining a positive grade from all colloquiums conducted during the semester. In case of a negative grade, the student has the right to improve it; an unexcused absence on a test results in forfeiture of the attempt. The student is required to have a language textbook and complete homework; failure to do so for more than half of the classes may result in denial of credit, even if all colloquiums are passed. The final grade is the arithmetic mean of all grades obtained from passing individual semesters and the foreign language exam. The condition for admission to the exam is passing the compulsory language course semesters.
